views.label: All
views.membership: Every outbound record the caller may read.

views.label: Triage
views.membership: Not packed, shipped or acknowledged yet; includes orders still waiting on catalog pairing.

views.label: Ready
views.membership: No unit picked, packed, labeled or scanned out, and not out of stock.

views.label: Pending
views.membership: A unit is picked, packed or labeled without a matched or applied label.

views.label: At risk
views.membership: Not scanned out, and either urgent or within two hours of its assignment deadline.

views.label: Ship now
views.membership: Packed or labeled with a matched or applied label.

views.label: Exceptions
views.membership: Out of stock, or the latest label ingestion is quarantined or failed.

views.label: Completed
views.membership: A unit has been scanned out.
